reader.requirement: At --std 85, when no GENERATE for a report has executed since its INITIATE, a TERMINATE for that report must produce no report group (no CF, PF, RF, PH, RH) and perform none of the related processing (no USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure, no control-break processing, no LINE-COUNTER/PAGE-COUNTER change), whatever the report defines and whatever happened to the control items or to other reports meanwhile.
reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior|CobolVersion in ReportWriter.cs: TerminateCore consults DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup and (through WithPageGroupControlValues) ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues, but both only INSIDE the `if (_started)` branch; the GR2 path (_started false: skip to _active = false) consults no edition. _started is set by GenerateCore's first successful GENERATE (after the GR10/inactive refusals) and cleared by Initiate and TerminateCore, with no edition test
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f01_03 covers INITIATE immediately followed by TERMINATE on a report with PH/DE/CF FINAL/PF; a GENERATE of another report in the interval, a changed control item, RH/RF/CH declared, a re-INITIATE after an earlier cycle that did GENERATE, and the summary GENERATE report-name form were probed here

probes.printed: CASE 1 (INITIATE, TERMINATE): no USE line, PC 01 LC 00 / CASE 2 (GENERATE of report R2 only, control item changed): no USE line, PC 01 LC 00 / CASE 3 (GENERATE R1 summary): USE RH1 PH1 CHF CHK DE1 CFK CFF PF1 RF1, LC 19 / CASE 4 (re-INITIATE, TERMINATE): no USE line, PC 01 LC 00 / CASE 5 (GENERATE DE1): all groups; file holds only the groups of cases 3 and 5
probes.expected: cases 1, 2, 4 produce nothing and run no USE procedure; a GENERATE report-name counts as a GENERATE (case 3 produces the terminating groups)
the same rule at the latest edition (§2023:14.9.46.4 GR2)
R2 TERMINATED PG 1 LC 00 with no R2 group or USE line

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR2  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: TerminateCore guards all group processing with `if (_started)`; only the inactive/GR10 refusals precede it and the state change to inactive follows it. Classes a, d, e, f do not reach this rule (no data operand). Side observation outside this rule: case 5's report heading after a re-INITIATE was written without a page feed after case 3's report footing; not judged here.

refuter.evidence: Read ReportWriter.cs#TerminateCore: every group action sits inside if (_started); _started is set only by a GENERATE that passed the GR10/inactive refusals and is cleared by Initiate. refute-1985-204/tm1.cob at --std 85 (runs/tm1-002): a GLOBAL report with 1985 CODE "XX", CONTROLS FINAL WS-K, RH/PH/CF FINAL/PF/RF, control item changed between INITIATE and TERMINATE: TERMINATE leaves PAGE-COUNTER 1, LINE-COUNTER 0 and the closed file holds 0 bytes (no RH, PF, CF, RF, no code prefix). Second cycle: the only GENERATE is executed in a contained program (CALL INNER) for the GLOBAL report; TERMINATE then produces the groups (62 bytes, LC 19), so a GENERATE from a contained program counts. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.7.4 GR2 'does not cause the report writer control system to produce any report groups'.
